title: Outline ring width contradicts across spec §0, README, and code (0.06 vs 0.03 vs 0.03)
evidence:
docs/silhouette-spec.md:29:
| Outline | thin dark ink plate `#33414F` at base, footprint + ~0.06 (≈2px in-game ring) | MM's defining edge |

assets/blender/README.md:26:
| Outline | thin dark ink `#33414F` plate at the base, footprint + ~0.03 (≈2px in-game ring) |

tools/gen_sprites.py:78:
OUTLINE_RING = 0.03   # ink ring width around the fill (scene units, ~2px in-game)
detail: The two contract docs the user sculpts against disagree, and §0 doubles the code's ring width. Nothing gates the contract, so a hand-sculpted §0-faithful export mismatches the pipeline.
recommended_fix: Align docs/silhouette-spec.md §0 to OUTLINE_RING = 0.03 (or deliberately change the constant) so the Blender-pass contract matches the pipeline.
